properties.title: Browser/OS
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields metadata.deviceType, metadata.browserName, metadata.osName
| filter event_type = "com.amazon.rum.page_view_event"
| stats count(*) by metadata.deviceType, metadata.browserName, metadata.osName

properties.title: Installed?
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields metadata.displayMode
| filter event_type = "com.amazon.rum.page_view_event"
| stats count(*) by metadata.displayMode

properties.title: Traffic
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields user_details.userId as userId, user_details.sessionId as sessionId
| filter event_type = "com.amazon.rum.page_view_event"
| stats count(*) as pageLoads, count_distinct(sessionId) as sessions, count_distinct(userId) as devices

properties.title: Font
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields event_details.textSize
| filter event_type = "text_size_preference"
| stats count(*) by event_details.textSize

properties.title: MinLevel
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields event_details.min as minLevel
| filter event_type = "dance_schedule_level_range"
| stats count(*) as sessions by minLevel
| fields case(minLevel = "SSD", 1,
              minLevel = "MS", 2,
              minLevel = "Plus", 3,
              minLevel = "A2", 4,
              minLevel = "C1", 5,
              minLevel = "C2", 6,
              minLevel = "C3A", 7,
              minLevel = "C3B", 8,
              9) as difficultyRank
| sort difficultyRank asc

properties.title: MaxLevel
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields event_details.max as maxLevel
| filter event_type = "dance_schedule_level_range"
| stats count(*) as sessions by maxLevel
| fields case(maxLevel = "SSD", 1,
              maxLevel = "MS", 2,
              maxLevel = "Plus", 3,
              maxLevel = "A2", 4,
              maxLevel = "C1", 5,
              maxLevel = "C2", 6,
              maxLevel = "C3A", 7,
              maxLevel = "C3B", 8,
              9) as difficultyRank
| sort difficultyRank asc

properties.title: Level Range
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields event_details.min as minLevel, event_details.max as maxLevel
| filter event_type = "dance_schedule_level_range"
| fields concat(minLevel, "-", maxLevel) as range
| stats count(*) as sessions by range
| sort sessions desc

properties.title: Platform Mix
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields metadata.osName, metadata.displayMode, user_details.sessionId as sessionId
| filter event_type = "com.amazon.rum.page_view_event"
| fields case(
    metadata.osName like /iOS/ and metadata.displayMode = "standalone", "Mobile PWA (iOS)",
    metadata.osName like /Android/ and metadata.displayMode = "standalone", "Mobile PWA (Android)",
    metadata.osName like /iOS/, "Mobile browser (iOS)",
    metadata.osName like /Android/, "Mobile browser (Android)",
    metadata.osName like /Mac/, "Desktop (Mac)",
    metadata.osName like /Windows/, "Desktop (PC)",
    "Other"
  ) as platform
| stats count_distinct(sessionId) as sessions by platform
| sort sessions desc

properties.title: Raw OS Permutations (diagnostic)
properties.query:
SOURCE dataSource(['amazon_cloudwatch.rum_app_monitor']) logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields metadata.osName, strlen(metadata.osName) as osNameLen, metadata.displayMode, metadata.deviceType, user_details.sessionId as sessionId
| filter event_type = "com.amazon.rum.page_view_event"
| stats count_distinct(sessionId) as sessions by metadata.osName, osNameLen, metadata.displayMode, metadata.deviceType
| sort sessions desc
